scope: Additive TH18 Home Village Super Bowler Triple Strike delta; preserves each preceding frozen reference.
game_version: The ordinary payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. The dated secondary table identifies client build 18.400.21; Supercell's notes do not identify a target client build.

sources.title: A New Super Troop & More!
sources.limitations: Officially establishes three damaging impacts and launch levels 4–6 but gives no current path, spacing, splash, flight or target-selection contract.

sources.title: June Update Is Around the Corner!
sources.limitations: Confirms the level-7 Home Village level, not current Triple Strike geometry.

sources.title: Super Bowler — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.limitations: Dated table supplies L4–10 HP/DPS, ground-only target type, 2.2-second cadence and 3-tile range, including L10 3,700 HP/310 DPS. It does not specify bounce geometry or tick lifecycle.

sources.title: Super Bowler | Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.limitations: Reports a 0.6-tile ground splash and three bounces but provides no version-identified flight, path, collision or timing contract.

official_deltas.behavior: Each attack has three damaging impacts.

damage_per_shot.derivation: 310 DPS × 2.2-second dated secondary cadence; replace if a current cadence changes.

bounce_impact_count.note: Primary-sourced number of damaging impacts per attack.

bounce_splash_radius_tiles.note: Secondary version-unknown reported splash radius; use remains partial.

bounce_step_tiles.note: Documented deterministic approximation: the dated table's 3-tile initial range is reused as each forward bounce step until a measured current path is available.

support.note: Core creates three serialized fixed splash impacts on the primary launch ray. Three impacts are primary; 0.6 splash and the 3-tile step are secondary/approximate.

changed_values.previous_state: catalogued-only despite primary confirmation of three impacts
changed_values.replacement: current L10 corrected from secondary dated build and three fixed serialized impact centers
changed_values.justification: The lenient goal permits a documented ray/spacing approximation where the impact count is primary but exact bounce geometry is not public.

known_uncertainties: No source defines bounce spacing, whether impact centers are fixed on a line or retargeted, intermediate target loss, per-impact target eligibility, Walls, collision width, flight, bounce delay or tick order.

The 0.6 splash radius is secondary and version-unknown. Core's three-tile forward step, simultaneous T+10-ms fixed impacts and ground-only filter are replaceable deterministic approximations, not fidelity claims.
The dated secondary table identifies client build 18.400.21, not the exact target build represented by the frozen September 2026 reference.
conclusion: This delta exposes the primary-confirmed Triple Strike through the shared adapters while preserving all geometric and timing gaps for later correction.
